configurations.name: dev
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null; export CF_SEND_TELEMETRY=false; npm run dev

configurations.name: preview
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null; export CF_SEND_TELEMETRY=false; npm run build && npm run start
